headline.lead: AI picks Klaviyo in 63 of 70 answers. Its main live reason, revenue attribution, is out of date. Address it first on the comparison page.

points.text: Klaviyo is picked in 63 of 70 answers. GetResponse wins 2, all on price or all-in-one value.
Live search doesn't correct the revenue-reporting claim: 63% of search-off answers make it, 57% of live ones. GetResponse now reports revenue per message and per workflow.
Price is the main reason AI ever picks GetResponse, but it only holds at bigger lists. At 1k contacts the plan with abandoned cart costs $59 against Klaviyo's $30.

priority.reason: Outdated, and search doesn't fix it: 63% of search-off and 57% of live answers make the claim, and Claude gives it as its stated reason in 8 of 10 live answers. GetResponse reports revenue per message and workflow (Marketer and up). It's the clearest fix we can prove.
Top store need and repeated almost everywhere. Browse abandonment and price drop campaigns are new (Apr 2026) and answers miss them. Back-in-stock is still missing, so say so.
The main reason AI picks GetResponse at all. True at 10k contacts, not at 1k on the plan stores need. Show a list-size table by plan so the claim survives a check.
High need, and it holds: the Shopify app has 1 review rated 1.0. Cover it honestly. This is a product fix more than a page fix.
Live search adds this objection: 5 of 30 search-off answers raise it, 12 of 40 live ones. Starter has no abandoned cart. Name the plan that does, up front.
Repeated almost everywhere and true: AI recommendations are Enterprise only; no predictive CLV or churn found. Don't contest it. Narrow it.
Google's AI Overviews credit it more than the chatbots do. No primary source settles it. Don't lead with it.
SMS is Enterprise only (MAX), but few answers raise it. One honest line is enough.
Already credited and true (Creator plan). Low store need, so it goes last.

gapNote: Live search barely changes what AI says: the claims AI makes are about as common with search on as off. Claude with search on cited getresponse.com in 0 of 10 answers, Gemini in 1. ChatGPT cited it in 9 of 10 and still credited Klaviyo with better attribution. Google quotes GetResponse's own comparison page for price ($15/mo, $65 at 10k), which looks like Starter pricing, the plan without abandoned cart. Check that page's figures, and state revenue attribution and the new flows in plain, dated lines so live engines have something to quote.
how: 10 fixed prompts, the same for every engine, asked as US, logged out. Prompts 1 and 2 swap the name order.
Claude: Anthropic API (claude-sonnet-5-5), search off then on. ChatGPT: OpenAI API (gpt-5.2), search off then forced on. No account context or memory.

Gemini: API (gemini-3.1-pro-preview), no search then Google Search grounding; it chose to search on 7 of 10. Google: the AI Overview in a logged-out browser on a US VPN, plus the top 3 organic results.
Training data = Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini with search off (30 answers). Live = the same three with search on, plus Google (40).
Claims are tagged by one Claude classifier across all 70 answers.
Primary sources = GetResponse's pricing page, blog, help docs and Shopify listing. Klaviyo prices come from third-party sources.
Not covered yet: logged-in runs, non-US results, Perplexity and Copilot.
